sharewise.en: Local privacy check before sharing photos/videos (yes/no counts only, never leaking GPS/time/device) plus verified clean redacted copies.

belajar-pemula.id: Mode belajar ramah pemula total ('tinggal ngobrol' tanpa /command): cek level & energi, ajarkan 1 konsep per balasan, pilih otomatis LearnLoop, Chalk (papan tulis visual), CodeCoach/Shikaku, atau OSSU.
belajar-pemula.en: Total-beginner friendly learning mode (natural chat without /commands): checks level & energy, teaches one concept per turn, and auto-routes to LearnLoop, Chalk, CodeCoach/Shikaku, or OSSU.

riset-mendalam-nusantara-global.id: Khusus Val: pipeline riset mendalam 10 tahap (Quick/Standard/Deep, adequacy gate, devil's advocate, audit klaim & sitasi) dengan metodologi akademik Indonesia (Bab I-V, SINTA 1-6, Garuda, RAMA, EYD V) & global (Scopus/WoS, PRISMA 2020).
riset-mendalam-nusantara-global.en: Val-only: 10-stage adaptive deep-research pipeline (Quick/Standard/Deep, adequacy gate, devil's advocate, claim & citation audit) with original Indonesian (Bab I-V, SINTA 1-6, Garuda, RAMA, EYD V) and global (Scopus/WoS, PRISMA 2020) methodology.

rust-anything.id: Khusus Coder (Shikaku): migrasi & porting bertahap kode TS/JS/Python/C/Go/Ruby/Java ke Rust dengan rekaman ground-truth, diff, benchmark, shadow, dan gate kelulusan (CLI/MCP rust-anything terpisah).
rust-anything.en: Coder-only (Shikaku): incremental verified porting of TS/JS/Python/C/Go/Ruby/Java code or whole apps to Rust via behavioral recording, diff, bench, shadow, and gate (separate rust-anything CLI/MCP).

lemo-opuscar.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii di MSSHI Core v3.2.0 (default OFF): katalog 15 kategori & 99 gaya film pendek berbasis kode (Lemo-Opuscar) dengan cache teks terpin on-demand.
lemo-opuscar.en: Optional Kiki-Chii integration in MSSHI Core v3.2.0 (default OFF): catalog of 15 categories and 99 code-driven short-film styles (Lemo-Opuscar) via pinned text-only cache.

modern-web-guidance.id: Khusus Coder (Shikaku): panduan fitur web modern Baseline (Chrome/Edge/Firefox/MDN), elemen native HTML/CSS/JS, aksesibilitas, dan Core Web Vitals.
modern-web-guidance.en: Coder-only (Shikaku): Baseline modern web platform guidance (Chrome/Edge/Firefox/MDN), native HTML/CSS/JS features, accessibility, and Core Web Vitals.

open-code-review.id: Khusus Coder (Shikaku): review kode hibrida deterministik + verifikasi baris-per-baris (Alibaba OpenCodeReview / CLI ocr) untuk git diff, commit, dan PR.
open-code-review.en: Coder-only (Shikaku): hybrid deterministic + line-level verified code review (Alibaba OpenCodeReview / ocr CLI) for git diffs, commits, and PRs.

ast-grep.id: Khusus Coder (Shikaku): pencarian struktural Tree-sitter AST, aturan lint YAML, dan refaktor codemod deterministik lintas berkas (ast-grep / sg).
ast-grep.en: Coder-only (Shikaku): deterministic Tree-sitter AST structural search, YAML linting, and multi-file codemod refactoring (ast-grep / sg).

knip.id: Khusus Coder (Shikaku): audit deterministik berkas mati, ekspor/tipe tak terpakai, dan dependensi yatim pada proyek JS/TS & monorepo (webpro-nl/knip).
knip.en: Coder-only (Shikaku): deterministic detection of unused files, exports/types, and dependencies in JS/TS projects and monorepos (webpro-nl/knip).

mcp-for-blender.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii (default OFF): MCP for Blender dua arah untuk modeling 3D, material, kamera previz, dan ekspor .glb/.gltf on-demand.
mcp-for-blender.en: Optional Kiki-Chii integration (default OFF): two-way MCP for Blender supporting 3D modeling, materials, camera previz, and on-demand .glb/.gltf export.

raea.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii (default OFF): RAEA Render Anything Engine (React/TS + Bevy GPU) untuk render langsung berbasis kode atau finishing hibrida .glb/.gltf dari mcp-for-blender.
raea.en: Optional Kiki-Chii integration (default OFF): RAEA Render Anything Engine (React/TS + Bevy GPU) for direct code-to-GPU renders or hybrid finishing of .glb/.gltf assets from mcp-for-blender.

cindy-grand-plan.id: Tampilkan peta perencanaan besar interaktif lintas-bot dan skill khusus saat diminta proyek besar agar pengguna dapat mengoreksi rencana sendiri sebelum eksekusi berat.
cindy-grand-plan.en: Display an interactive cross-bot and skill Grand Execution Blueprint on big-plan requests so the user can review and revise the plan before heavy execution.

meshy-3d-generation.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii: generasi model 3D dari teks/gambar (GLB/FBX/OBJ/USDZ) dan 3D printing lewat Meshy CLI dengan sign-in device code.
meshy-3d-generation.en: Optional for Kiki-Chii: generate 3D assets from text or images (GLB/FBX/OBJ/USDZ) and prepare 3D prints via Meshy CLI with device-code sign-in.

meme-studio-suite.id: Khusus Kiki-Chii (Rp0, tanpa API key wajib): studio meme terpadu yang menyatukan makememe (memegen.link), awesome-meme (27+ template programmer Pillow/YAML), meme-lord (pola viral + A/B 6 dimensi lokal tanpa Visa/Exa/fal.ai), dan createa-meme-skill (caption-craft).
meme-studio-suite.en: Kiki-Chii Rp0 Meme Studio Suite unifying makememe (zero-key memegen.link), awesome-meme (27+ local Pillow/YAML programmer templates), meme-lord (viral patterns + local 6-dimension A/B rating without Visa/Exa/fal.ai), and createa-meme-skill (caption-craft).

makememe.id: Generator URL & PNG meme klasik 100% gratis tanpa API key via api.memegen.link.
makememe.en: 100% free zero-API-key classic meme URL & PNG generator via api.memegen.link.

awesome-meme.id: Katalog 27+ template meme programmer & klasik lokal dengan perender Pillow + YAML.
awesome-meme.en: 27+ local programmer & classic meme templates with Pillow + YAML text rendering.

meme-lord.id: Konsep viral, ironic contrast, Two-Step Impact overlay, dan evaluasi A/B lokal 6 dimensi (tanpa Visa CLI, Exa berbayar, atau fal.ai).
meme-lord.en: Viral meme concepts, ironic contrast, Two-Step Impact overlay, and local 6-dimension A/B rating (excluding Visa CLI, paid Exa, and fal.ai).

createa-meme-skill.id: Panduan caption-craft ('find the turn', 2-6 kata/baris); MCP @createa/meme-mcp opsional hanya jika pengguna memiliki CAM_API_KEY sendiri.
createa-meme-skill.en: Caption-craft guide ('find the turn', 2-6 words/line); @createa/meme-mcp optional only if the user brings their own CAM_API_KEY.

core.id: Fondasi ideasi, gaya tulisan, persona, OCR, koordinasi, dan akses alat sesuai tugas.
core.en: Foundations for ideation, writing style, persona, OCR, coordination and task-based tool access.

filmmaking.id: Perencanaan film/foto, visual, motion graphics, dan video; produksi memakai alat yang disiapkan terpisah.
filmmaking.en: Film/photo planning, visuals, motion graphics and video; production uses separately configured tools.

business.id: Analisis usaha, skenario keuangan, dan perhitungan bisnis lewat harness lokal.
business.en: Business analysis, financial scenarios and calculations through a local harness.

thesis.id: Ide penelitian, literatur, metode, analisis data, penulisan, revisi, dan presentasi skripsi.
thesis.en: Research ideas, literature, methods, data analysis, writing, revision and thesis presentations.

webdev.id: Pemetaan proyek, pengembangan web/UI, eksperimen kode, dan pengujian.
webdev.en: Project mapping, web/UI development, code experiments and testing.

cybersec.id: Pemetaan kode dan panduan audit keamanan pada target yang izinnya jelas; engine dipasang terpisah.
cybersec.en: Code mapping and security-audit guidance for authorized targets; engines are installed separately.

solo.id: Pasang semua skill standar pada satu agen; REA tetap terpisah dan tidak aktif secara default.
solo.en: Install all standard skills for one agent; REA stays separate and OFF by default.

custom-bots.id: Buat jumlah, nama, dan peran bot sendiri, lalu pilih skill masing-masing.
custom-bots.en: Choose the number, names and roles of bots, then select each bot's skills.

selective.id: Pasang hanya kategori pilihan beserta skill fondasi yang diwajibkan paket.
selective.en: Install selected categories plus the package's mandatory foundation skills.

muza-preset.id: Buat tim Yukino untuk ide, Shizuka untuk koordinasi, Val untuk riset, Kiki untuk kreatif, dan Shikaku untuk kode.
muza-preset.en: Create a team: Yukino for ideas, Shizuka for coordination, Val for research, Kiki for creative work and Shikaku for code.

academic-mahasiswa.id: Academic Mahasiswa S1/S2/S3 (pilihan awal baru): lima peran untuk bimbingan, riset, kode dan sidang; catatan di workspace Hermes, akun/model milik pengguna.
academic-mahasiswa.en: Academic Students S1/S2/S3 (fresh-install initial choice): five roles for supervision, research, coding and defense; notes stay in Hermes workspace, with user-supplied accounts/models.

academic-dosen.id: Academic Dosen/Pimpinan Kampus: lima peran untuk RPS, mengajar, pembimbingan, riset, rapat dan tindak lanjut; tidak memasang Obsidian atau akun otomatis.
academic-dosen.en: Academic Lecturers/Campus Leadership: five roles for syllabi, teaching, supervision, research, meetings and follow-up; no automatic Obsidian or account setup.

hermes.id: Pasang ke folder skill Hermes Agent; akun dan model utama tetap milik pengguna.
hermes.en: Install into the Hermes Agent skills folder; the user retains control of accounts and the main model.

openclaw.id: Pasang instruksi skill untuk OpenClaw; koneksi layanan mengikuti setup OpenClaw pengguna.
openclaw.en: Install skill instructions for OpenClaw; service connections depend on the user's OpenClaw setup.

claude.id: Pasang ke folder skill Claude Code; untuk Claude.ai gunakan jalur unggah ZIP yang dijelaskan di README.
claude.en: Install into the Claude Code skills folder; for Claude.ai use the README's ZIP-upload route.

codex.id: Pasang ke folder skill Codex; ini bukan unggahan Knowledge ke ChatGPT.
codex.en: Install into the Codex skills folder; this does not upload Knowledge to ChatGPT.

antigravity.id: Pasang instruksi skill ke lokasi Antigravity yang dipilih tanpa mengganti model IDE.
antigravity.en: Install skill instructions into the selected Antigravity location without changing the IDE's model.

manual.id: Pilih sendiri folder tujuan untuk agen lain yang mendukung SKILL.md.
manual.en: Choose the destination folder for another agent that supports SKILL.md.

rea.id: Analisis statis JavaScript/arsip milik pengguna melalui CLI; berguna untuk memahami aplikasi dan artefak. Default Tidak; pilihan ini hanya memasang wrapper, bukan runtime atau engine native.
rea.en: Static CLI analysis of owned JavaScript/archives, useful for understanding applications and artifacts. Default No; this installs only the wrapper, not the runtime or native engines.

rea-runtime.id: Pasang dependency npm REA ke runtime terisolasi; memerlukan Node/npm yang kompatibel dan unduhan internet. Engine seperti Ghidra dipasang terpisah; tidak menambahkan server MCP.
rea-runtime.en: Install REA npm dependencies into an isolated runtime; compatible Node/npm and an internet download are required. Engines such as Ghidra are separate; no MCP server is registered.

pull-upstreams.id: Unduh repositori referensi eksternal ke cache untuk modul tambahan. Memakai internet dan ruang disk; tidak otomatis menjalankan kode atau menjamin dependency/akun siap.
pull-upstreams.en: Download external reference repositories into a cache for additional modules. Uses internet and disk space; it does not automatically run their code or make dependencies/accounts ready.

custom-display-names.id: Ubah nama tampilan bot pada preset; pembagian peran dan ID folder tetap sama.
custom-display-names.en: Change display names in the preset while keeping role assignments and folder IDs the same.

artcraft.id: Aplikasi kreatif opsional untuk foto, video, audio, desain, dan dokumen melalui adapter yang tersedia. Boleh dilewati; aplikasi, lisensi, atau akun layanan disiapkan terpisah dan tidak dibuka saat boot.
artcraft.en: Optional creative apps for photo, video, audio, design and documents through available adapters. You may skip them; apps, licenses or service accounts are separate and do not open at boot.

kat.id: Helper KAT opsional khusus Shikaku. Wizard menyiapkan endpoint, ID model dan referensi key; model utama/MoA tetap utuh. Dev perlu deployment nyata; preset resmi StreamLake menggunakan Pro v2.5 yang berbeda dan membutuhkan key serta saldo akun sendiri.
kat.en: Optional Shikaku-only KAT helper. The wizard configures an endpoint, model ID and key reference while preserving primary/MoA settings. Dev needs a real deployment; official StreamLake serves a different Pro v2.5 variant and needs its own key/account billing.

kat-light.id: Alias kompatibilitas pilihan lama: membuka wizard KAT, tanpa mengunduh model lokal. RAM 16 GB tidak membuktikan model muat; pilihan harus memiliki endpoint/key yang valid.
kat-light.en: Compatibility alias for the old choice: opens the KAT wizard, downloading no local model. 16 GB RAM does not prove fit; a valid endpoint/key is required.

kat-ideal.id: Alias pilihan lama yang membuka wizard endpoint; tidak memasang Q4 atau menjanjikan model 35B muat di laptop. Model utama Coder tidak diganti.
kat-ideal.en: Legacy choice alias opening endpoint setup; it neither installs Q4 nor promises a 35B model fits a laptop. The Coder primary model is preserved.

kat-cloud.id: Konfigurasikan endpoint KAT jarak jauh lewat wizard dan input key rahasia. KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev tidak mendapat URL hosted otomatis; preset StreamLake adalah Pro v2.5, berbayar dan berbeda varian.
kat-cloud.en: Configure a remote KAT endpoint through the wizard and hidden key input. Dev has no automatically supplied hosted URL; StreamLake is a paid, different Pro v2.5 variant.

kat-skip.id: Nonaktifkan helper KAT khusus Coder; semua model utama, delegasi biasa dan skill coding tetap tersedia.
kat-skip.en: Disable only the Coder KAT helper; primary models, normal delegation and coding skills remain available.

skill-vs-pack.id: Paket memilih kelompok skill sesuai bidang; skill individual memberi kontrol satu per satu. Skill fondasi wajib tetap disertakan, dan referensi eksternal belum tentu siap dijalankan.
skill-vs-pack.en: Packs select skill groups by subject; individual skills give one-by-one control. Mandatory foundations remain included, and external references are not necessarily ready to run.

voice.id: Suara lokal OmniVoice untuk audio atau baca-nyaring yang diminta; tidak otomatis menyuarakan setiap chat. Perlu bobot, RAM, dan setup audio; lisensi bobot membatasi penggunaan komersial.
voice.en: Local OmniVoice speech for requested audio or read-aloud, not every chat automatically. Requires weights, RAM and audio setup; the weights license restricts commercial use.

dream.id: Buat proposal rangkuman/pelajaran secara lokal dan deterministik dari bahan terpilih. Tidak memanggil LLM atau otomatis memasukkan proposal ke memori aktif.
dream.en: Create deterministic local summary/learning proposals from selected material. Does not call an LLM or automatically promote proposals into active memory.

steel.id: Dihentikan dari pemasang MSSHI. Pilih browser lokal dan lakukan login sendiri; tidak ada transfer akun/cookie.
steel.en: Retired from the MSSHI installer. Select a local browser and sign in yourself; no account or cookie transfer.

gitlab.id: GitLab tidak disambungkan atau diberi kredensial oleh installer MSSHI. Hubungkan sendiri melalui pengaturan resmi layanan bila diperlukan; biaya dan izin mengikuti akun pengguna.
gitlab.en: GitLab is not connected or provisioned with credentials by the MSSHI installer. Connect it manually using the service settings when needed; costs and permissions belong to the user account.

tinyfish.id: Tinyfish tidak disambungkan atau diberi kredensial oleh installer MSSHI. Hubungkan sendiri melalui pengaturan resmi layanan bila diperlukan; biaya dan izin mengikuti akun pengguna.
tinyfish.en: Tinyfish is not connected or provisioned with credentials by the MSSHI installer. Connect it manually using the service settings when needed; costs and permissions belong to the user account.

brightdata.id: BrightData tidak disambungkan atau diberi kredensial oleh installer MSSHI. Hubungkan sendiri melalui pengaturan resmi layanan bila diperlukan; biaya dan izin mengikuti akun pengguna.
brightdata.en: BrightData is not connected or provisioned with credentials by the MSSHI installer. Connect it manually using the service settings when needed; costs and permissions belong to the user account.

llmtrim.id: Padatkan keluaran JSON besar yang memenuhi syarat tanpa kehilangan nilai, dengan pemeriksaan kesetaraan. Tidak memadatkan semua chat atau menjamin persentase penghematan tagihan tertentu.
llmtrim.en: Compact eligible large JSON outputs without losing values, with an equality check. Does not compress every chat or guarantee a particular billing reduction.

hersona.id: Cari referensi persona dan siapkan draf penyesuaian karakter melalui CLI. Persona aktif tetap mengikuti SOUL native; draf tidak otomatis menimpa pengaturan pengguna.
hersona.en: Find persona references and prepare character-adjustment drafts through the CLI. Active persona still follows native SOUL; drafts do not automatically overwrite user settings.

timesfm-runtime.id: Siapkan dependency dan bobot TimesFM untuk prediksi deret waktu lokal. Memerlukan unduhan, ruang disk, dan RAM cukup; uji kecil bukan jaminan akurasi pada data pengguna.
timesfm-runtime.en: Set up TimesFM dependencies and weights for local time-series forecasts. Requires downloads, disk space and enough RAM; a small test does not guarantee accuracy on user data.

brag-runtime.id: Siapkan Hyperframes untuk memvalidasi dan merender video lokal dari komposisi HTML yang dapat diedit. Perlu Node, browser/FFmpeg yang sesuai, RAM/disk, dan hak aset; font dapat memerlukan unduhan.
brag-runtime.en: Set up Hyperframes to validate and render local video from editable HTML compositions. Needs Node, a compatible browser/FFmpeg, RAM/disk and asset rights; fonts may need downloads.

scrapling-runtime.id: Siapkan parser terisolasi untuk ekstraksi CSS/XPath dari file HTML lokal. Memerlukan dependency Python yang kompatibel; opsi ini tidak menyediakan browser stealth atau crawler jaringan.
scrapling-runtime.en: Set up an isolated parser for CSS/XPath extraction from local HTML files. Requires compatible Python dependencies; this option supplies no stealth browser or network crawler.

harness2-runtime.id: Siapkan framework untuk demo perbaikan harness yang deterministik dan proposal eksperimen. Perlu Python/dependency yang kompatibel; benchmark berbasis model dan promosi perubahan ke bot tidak otomatis aktif.
harness2-runtime.en: Set up the framework for deterministic harness-improvement demos and experiment proposals. Needs compatible Python/dependencies; model-backed benchmarks and promotion into the bot are not automatically enabled.

managed-update.id: Perbarui salinan skill yang terdaftar dan fingerprint-nya cocok; pertahankan edit lokal yang berbeda. Pendaftaran ini bukan izin mengganti SOUL, provider/model, atau semua dependency runtime.
managed-update.en: Update registered skill copies whose fingerprints match, preserving differing local edits. Enrollment does not authorize replacing SOUL, provider/model or every runtime dependency.

upstream-cache.id: Simpan checkout referensi eksternal di luar folder skill agar dapat diperiksa atau diintegrasikan terpisah. Cache memakai internet/disk dan tidak sama dengan fitur yang sudah terpasang atau aktif.
upstream-cache.en: Keep external reference checkouts outside skill folders for separate review or integration. The cache uses internet/disk and is not the same as an installed or active capability.

setup-skills.id: Tambahkan paket atau skill individual ekstra dan kelola skill opsional REA per bot saat setup tanpa mengubah skill kustom yang sudah ada.
setup-skills.en: Add extra skill packs or individual skills and manage optional REA wrappers per bot during setup without overwriting custom skills.

setup-plugins.id: Kelola addon lokal opsional seperti auto-trim, KAT, laporan Dreaming offline dan OmniVoice bila telah diverifikasi. Tidak memasang browser cloud atau koneksi layanan otomatis.
setup-plugins.en: Manage optional local addons such as auto-trim, KAT, offline Dreaming reports, and verified OmniVoice. No cloud browser or automatic service connection is installed.

setup-services.id: Pilih Chrome, Edge, Firefox, atau tidak memilih browser; simpan label profil/akun untuk login manual. Tidak memasang layanan eksternal, membuka browser, membaca akun, atau menyalin cookie.
setup-services.en: Choose Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or none; store profile/account labels for manual login. Never installs external services, opens a browser, reads accounts, or copies cookies.

setup-bot-apps.id: Hubungkan tiap profil bot ke jembatan CLI-Anything dan aplikasi lokal atau web secara on-demand memakai tiket tugas, dengan auto_open_on_boot tetap nonaktif.
setup-bot-apps.en: Connect selected bot profiles to CLI-Anything bridges and local or web apps on demand via task tickets while keeping auto_open_on_boot disabled.

context-sources.id: Cache source terpin CareerOps, direktori remote, Matt Pocock dan rea-video di luar skills; default status tidak mengunduh atau menjalankan model.
context-sources.en: Cache pinned CareerOps, remote-directory, Matt Pocock and rea-video sources outside skills; default status downloads nothing and runs no model.

career-ops-runtime.id: Pasang dependency Node secara eksplisit tanpa lifecycle scripts atau unduhan Chromium; CV/data pengguna tetap privat, tugas dan akun terpisah.
career-ops-runtime.en: Explicitly install Node dependencies without lifecycle scripts or Chromium downloads; personal CV/data remains private and tasks/accounts are separate.

rea-video-runtime.id: Pasang runtime Python terisolasi; analisis lokal dapat melewati OCR/ASR/stems/VLM. Fitur model, unduhan bobot dan generasi tidak otomatis aktif.
rea-video-runtime.en: Install an isolated Python runtime; local analysis can skip OCR/ASR/stems/VLM. Model features, weights and generation are not automatically enabled.

interaction.id: Protokol interaksi terpisah (msshi.interaction-protocol): Tier 0 Main-only untuk obrolan singkat; Tipe 1 (Advisor pada Yukino/Shizuka); Tipe 2 (Dewan 2 putaran dengan dossier ringkas + audit Main pada Val/Kiki-Chii/Shikaku). Mendukung pemulihan stale lock (recover_lock tanpa retry berbayar), ringkasan job per sesi, dan retensi terminal opt-in (14 hari/simpan 20; auto-prune OFF).
interaction.en: Dedicated interaction protocol (msshi.interaction-protocol): Tier 0 Main-only for brief chats; Type 1 (Advisor on Yukino/Shizuka); Type 2 (2-round Council with compact dossiers + Main audit on Val/Kiki-Chii/Shikaku). Supports dead-PID stale-lock recovery (recover_lock without paid retry), per-session job summaries, and opt-in terminal retention (14d/keep 20; auto-prune OFF).

light-build.id: Mode ringan Windows 10 RAM 4 GB (paket <= 50 MB, indeks skill lazy, batas 1 inferensi/proses aktif, tanpa pengunduhan aset/PDF otomatis, tanpa mengubah model atau API key pengguna).
light-build.en: Windows 10 4 GB RAM Light Build mode (<= 50 MB core bundle, lazy skill index, single active inference/process cap, deferred heavy assets/PDFs, without changing user models or API keys).

cognitive-system.id: Sistem Interaksi Cerdas 5 Misi Utama + 4 Pilar (msshi system status|route|cycle): Belajar/Guru, Tugas/Skripsi/Tesis/Disertasi, Konten Kreasi, Coding, dan Teman Curhat & Daily Scheduling; menyatukan MSSHITrim, Caveman, lazy context-sources, msshi-interaction, Hermes-Dreaming, Harness2, dan Val+TimesFM 2.5 secara lokal (0 panggilan LLM, tanpa mengubah model/provider).
cognitive-system.en: 5-Mission + 4-Pillar Closed-Loop Cognitive Operating System (msshi system status|route|cycle): Tutor/Learning, Academic/Thesis, Content Creation, Coding, and Daily Companion/Scheduling; unifies MSSHITrim, Caveman, lazy context-sources, msshi-interaction, Hermes-Dreaming, Harness2, and Val+TimesFM 2.5 locally (0 LLM calls, zero provider/model changes).

imagination-studio.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii / Content Creator (default OFF): menghubungkan alur Filmmaker (Concepting First -> MFA 5 Fase) dengan Slate planning & antrean render lokal Imagination Studio (127.0.0.1:7870) via plugin Hermes atau stdio MCP.
imagination-studio.en: Optional Kiki-Chii / Content Creator integration (default OFF): connects Filmmaker (Concepting First -> 5 MFA Phases) with Imagination Studio Slate planning and local render queues (127.0.0.1:7870) via the Hermes plugin or stdio MCP.

imagination-studio-runtime.id: Aplikasi Imagination Studio (Keys & Sam Wasserman / TensorFold), plugin resmi Hermes (hermes plugins install imagination-studio, Hermes >= 0.22.7), dan bobot model dipasang terpisah oleh pengguna sesuai RAM/GPU (atau via ComfyUI PC/Comfy Cloud).
imagination-studio-runtime.en: The Imagination Studio app (Keys & Sam Wasserman / TensorFold), official Hermes plugin (hermes plugins install imagination-studio, Hermes >= 0.22.7), and model weights are installed separately by the user according to RAM/GPU (or via remote ComfyUI/Comfy Cloud).

spacewise.id: Plugin & skill lokal Spacewise (MIT, tanpa jaringan): pindai 1 folder persis, tampilkan pratinjau lokal, pindahkan kategori yang disetujui ke Trash (macOS/Linux; Windows mode laporan).
spacewise.en: Local Spacewise plugin & skill (MIT, zero network): scan one literal folder, build local preview, move approved categories to Trash (macOS/Linux; Windows report-only).

sharewise.id: Plugin & skill lokal Sharewise (MIT, tanpa jaringan): audit metadata foto/video Wall T1 (ya/tidak saja), halaman review lokal, dan salinan bersih tanpa mengubah file asli.
sharewise.en: Local Sharewise plugin & skill (MIT, zero network): Wall T1 photo/video metadata audit (yes/no only), local review page, and verified clean copies without altering originals.

ossu-computer-science.id: Koneksi ke Universitas Computer Science Open-Source OSSU (https://cs.ossu.dev | ossu/computer-science, MIT) lewat 'msshi ossu roadmap|courses|open'. Bukan skill bot — mahasiswa dapat langsung membuka kurikulum dasar CS (Intro CS -> Core CS -> Advanced CS -> Final Project) dan belajar bertahap bersama Hermes.
ossu-computer-science.en: Connection to the Open Source Society University (OSSU) Computer Science curriculum (https://cs.ossu.dev | ossu/computer-science, MIT) via 'msshi ossu roadmap|courses|open'. Not a bot skill — students can directly open CS fundamentals (Intro CS -> Core CS -> Advanced CS -> Final Project) and study interactively through Hermes.

learn-mode.id: Mode Belajar Pemula ('msshi learn status|start|install') yang memadukan Chalk (MIT, bundel), LearnLoop (AGPL-3.0 opt-in dari upstream), CodeCoach (MIT Linux/WSL2 + fallback Shikaku di Windows), dan OSSU.
learn-mode.en: Beginner Learning Mode ('msshi learn status|start|install') unifying bundled Chalk (MIT), opt-in LearnLoop (AGPL-3.0 direct from upstream), CodeCoach (MIT Linux/WSL2 + Shikaku Windows fallback), and OSSU.

upstreams-check.id: Pemeriksa update GitHub upstream ('msshi upstreams check|integrity') bersifat read-only: hanya memberi tahu jika ada commit baru tanpa memasang otomatis.
upstreams-check.en: Read-only GitHub upstream update notifier ('msshi upstreams check|integrity'): reports newer commits without auto-applying or mutating pinned revisions.

skill-finder.id: Pencari skill otomatis lintas semua 6 bot termasuk default lewat tool in-process 'msshi_find_skill' (search/open) dan CLI 'msshi find': mencari di skill aktif bot saat ini, bot spesialis lain, sumber terhubung, dan brankas arsip lokal (0 panggilan LLM; menjaga batas spesialis & confinement arsip).
skill-finder.en: Automatic cross-bot lazy skill finder across all 6 profiles including default via native in-process tool 'msshi_find_skill' (search/open) and CLI 'msshi find': searches active bot skills, specialist teammates, connected sources, and archived skill vaults (0 LLM calls; enforces specialist ownership and archive confinement).

mcp-for-blender.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii (default OFF, auto_open_on_boot=false): pasang wrapper MCP for Blender (ahujasid/mcp-for-blender) setelah rute Blender diputus dari CLI-Anything.
mcp-for-blender.en: Optional Kiki-Chii wrapper (default OFF, auto_open_on_boot=false): installs MCP for Blender instructions (ahujasid/mcp-for-blender) replacing the disconnected CLI-Anything Blender route.

mcp-for-blender-runtime.id: Blender 3.0+, addon.py resmi, dan server stdio uvx mcp-for-blender (atau uvx blender-mcp) dipasang serta dihubungkan sendiri oleh pengguna hanya saat sesi 3D aktif.
mcp-for-blender-runtime.en: Blender 3.0+, official addon.py, and the uvx mcp-for-blender (or uvx blender-mcp) stdio server are installed and connected separately by the user only during active 3D tasks.

raea.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii (default OFF): pasang wrapper RAEA — Render Anything Engine (shinyobjectz/raea) untuk render langsung React/TS + Bevy GPU atau hibrida bersama .glb/.gltf dari mcp-for-blender. Berbeda dari optional/rea milik Coder.
raea.en: Optional Kiki-Chii wrapper (default OFF): installs RAEA — Render Anything Engine instructions (shinyobjectz/raea) for direct React/TS + Bevy GPU rendering or hybrid .glb/.gltf workflows with mcp-for-blender. Separate from Coder's optional/rea.

raea-runtime.id: Engine RAEA (FSL-1.1-ALv2, 0 byte kode upstream dipaketkan di MSSHI), GPU Vulkan/Metal/DX12, dan Rust/Node dipasang terpisah oleh pengguna; perangkat Low-RAM otomatis diarahkan ke BRAG/Hyperframes.
raea-runtime.en: The RAEA engine (FSL-1.1-ALv2, zero upstream bytes bundled in MSSHI), compatible Vulkan/Metal/DX12 GPU, and Rust/Node toolchains are installed separately by the user; Low-RAM hosts fall back cleanly to BRAG/Hyperframes.

lemo-opuscar.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii pada MSSHI Core v3.2.0 (default OFF): katalog 15 kategori & 99 gaya film pendek berbasis kode (Lemo-Opuscar) dengan penjelasan kategori wajib sebelum memilih 1 STYLE.md.
lemo-opuscar.en: Optional Kiki-Chii wrapper in MSSHI Core v3.2.0 (default OFF): 15-category / 99-style code-driven short-film catalog (Lemo-Opuscar) explaining categories first before loading 1 STYLE.md.

lemo-opuscar-runtime.id: Metadata teks/JSON Lemo-Opuscar diunduh on-demand ke cache privat msshi-private/context-sources (0 aset video/gambar berat di skills/); alat render Node/FFmpeg/Chromium terpisah.
lemo-opuscar-runtime.en: Lemo-Opuscar text/JSON style guides are fetched on demand into msshi-private/context-sources (zero heavy media in skills/); Node/FFmpeg/Chromium renderers are installed separately.

cindy-grand-plan.id: Gerbang perencanaan besar kontekstual lintas 5 bot pada semua preset: hanya aktif pada rencana besar untuk menampilkan tahapan, bot, skill, dan titik cek agar dikoreksi pengguna lebih dulu.
cindy-grand-plan.en: Contextual Grand-Plan preview gate across all 5 bots in all presets: triggers only on big plans to show stages, bot handoffs, skills, and checkpoints for user correction first.

meshy-3d-generation.id: Opsional khusus Kiki-Chii (default OFF): pasang wrapper Meshy 3D Agent (meshy-dev/meshy-3d-agent) untuk generasi model 3D GLB/FBX/OBJ/USDZ & 3D printing.
meshy-3d-generation.en: Optional Kiki-Chii wrapper (default OFF): installs Meshy 3D Agent instructions (meshy-dev/meshy-3d-agent) for GLB/FBX/OBJ/USDZ 3D generation and 3D printing.

meshy-3d-generation-runtime.id: Memerlukan Node.js >= 22.12, meshy-cli@0.8, sign-in kode perangkat (https://www.meshy.ai/device), serta paket Meshy Pro+ saat membuat tugas generasi 3D.
meshy-3d-generation-runtime.en: Requires Node.js >= 22.12, meshy-cli@0.8, one-time device-code sign-in (https://www.meshy.ai/device), and a Meshy Pro+ plan when creating 3D generation tasks.
